title: The Woodcutter's Bell
rumor: The Woodcutter's Bell. An old iron bell hangs from a branch somewhere in the forest, though no building stands nearby. It reportedly rings whenever a traveler becomes lost, and those who follow the sound sometimes discover a safe trail home. Others claim the bell sounds only before a death among the nearby lumber camps.
first_lead: Several independent loggers know a woodland crossroads where the bell was last heard.
